{{Top|leg}}
The '''hospital module''' was a [[Mission Function Module]] designed to be used with the [[modular taskforce cruiser]]. It was intended for use during [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] disasters, anti-[[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] clean up operations, and space battle recovery. The module was tasked to deal with emergencies ranging from combat injuries to [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] leaks. It was staffed by 225 [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], 400 [[Nurse/Legends|nurses]], 1,500 [[emergency medical technician]]s, and 1,000 [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]]. The hospital module could care for 2,750 patients in [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], 1,000 patients in quarantine, and 19,600 in general wards. It could carry 5,000 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo, including thousands of [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] and [[repulsorlift stretcher]]s, and five [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. The module cost 750,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
